title: Stone Game II
problemStatement: Given piles of stones arranged in a row, two players alternately remove the first X remaining piles where 1 ≤ X ≤ 2M, with M updated after every move. Determine the maximum number of stones the first player can collect assuming optimal play.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers.
output: Print the maximum stones obtainable by the first player.
